question: As of 1 March 2025, who became the Chairman of the Securities and Exchange Board of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tuhin Kanta Pandey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tuhin Kanta Pandey**, a **1987-batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS)** officer of the **Odisha cadre**, assumed the role of **Chairman** of the **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)** on **1 March 2025**.
 
• He succeeded **Madhabi Puri Buch**, whose tenure as the first woman chairperson of the regulatory body concluded in **February 2025**.
 
• The **Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC)** approved his appointment for a period of **three years** or until further orders, whichever is earlier.
 
• Prior to this prestigious appointment, **Tuhin Kanta Pandey** served as the **Finance Secretary** and Secretary of the **Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM)** under the **Ministry of Finance**.
 
• His vast experience in **disinvestment**, **public asset management**, and **financial regulation** is expected to guide the Indian capital markets through evolving global economic landscapes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI):**
 
 
• It was established on **April 12, 1988**, and was initially a non-statutory body. It gained **statutory powers** on **January 30, 1992**, following the enactment of the **SEBI Act, 1992**.
 
• The **headquarters** of SEBI is located in the business district of **Bandra Kurla Complex** in **Mumbai**, with regional offices in **New Delhi**, **Kolkata**, **Chennai**, and **Ahmedabad**.
 
• The primary **functions** of SEBI include protecting the interests of investors in securities, promoting the development of the securities market, and regulating the market through various guidelines and **Acts**.
 
 
 
• **Important Personalities in SEBI:**
 
 
• **Madhabi Puri Buch**: Appointed in **March 2022**, she was the first woman to lead SEBI and the first person from the private sector to hold the post.
 
• **Ananth Narayan G** and **Ashwani Bhatia**: They serve as **Whole-Time Members (WTM)** of SEBI, contributing to the decision-making process alongside the Chairman.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Chairman** of SEBI is appointed by the **Government of India** on the recommendation of the **Financial Sector Regulatory Appointments Search Committee (FSRASC)**.
 
• The structure of the **SEBI Board** typically consists of the **Chairman**, two members from the **Union Finance Ministry**, one member from the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, and five other members, of whom at least three shall be whole-time members.
 
• During his tenure at **DIPAM**, **Tuhin Kanta Pandey** played a crucial role in high-profile **disinvestments**, including the privatization of **Air India** and the **Initial Public Offering (IPO)** of the **Life Insurance Corporation (LIC)** in **2022**.
